# gRPC health check (`source_type: grpc`)

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-probe-refs.ts from packages/probe-config. Do not edit by hand. -->

Calls the standard gRPC health service (grpc.health.v1.Health/Check). Reports 1 for SERVING and 0 for NOT_SERVING, or the round trip in milliseconds with `interpretation: latency`.

- Runs on: an Observer Agent (set the metric's `agent` to its name)
- Thresholds: required when the metric is created (all four fields)
- testProbe: supported

## Value and unit

- `interpretation: health_state` (default): no unit: 1 when the health check reports SERVING, 0 when NOT_SERVING
- `interpretation: latency`: `ms`: health check round-trip time in milliseconds

## source_config fields

| Field | Required | Type | Default | Limits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `host` | yes | string |  |  |
| `port` | yes | integer |  | 1 to 65535 |
| `service` | no | string |  | up to 256 characters |
| `tls_mode` | no | enum | `"plaintext"` | `plaintext`, `tls`, `mtls` |
| `client_cert_ref` | no | string |  | env var name on the agent host (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE) |
| `client_key_ref` | no | string |  | env var name on the agent host (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE) |
| `ca_cert_ref` | no | string |  | env var name on the agent host (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE) |
| `metadata` | no | object |  |  |
| `metadata_refs` | no | object |  | values are env var names on the agent host |
| `timeout_ms` | no | integer | `5000` | 100 to 30000 |
| `interpretation` | no | enum | `"health_state"` | `health_state`, `latency` |

## Rules

- Only the health checking protocol is supported, not arbitrary methods. Leave `service` empty to check the whole server.
- `tls_mode: mtls` needs `client_cert_ref` and `client_key_ref`.
- `metadata` is stored by Observer, so credential-looking keys are rejected there. Put secrets in `metadata_refs` (key to env var name). Keys starting with `grpc-` and binary `-bin` keys are not allowed.

## Example

```yaml
source_type: grpc
source_config: {"host":"orders.internal","port":50051,"tls_mode":"plaintext"}
```
